hooks.command: SCANNER=$(find . -path '*/observability_coverage/analyzers/scan.py' -print -quit 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$SCANNER" ]; then exit 0; fi; TOOL_INPUT=$(cat); FILE_PATH=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.filePath // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$FILE_PATH" ] || ! echo "$FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|py|go|java|rb|rs)$'; then exit 0; fi; if echo "$FILE_PATH" | grep -qiE '(test_|_test\.|spec\.|__tests__)'; then exit 0; fi; RESULT=$(python3 "$SCANNER" "$FILE_PATH" --json 2>/dev/null); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then exit 0; fi; CRIT=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.critical // 0' 2>/dev/null); HIGH=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.high // 0' 2>/dev/null); TOTAL=$((CRIT + HIGH)); if [ "$TOTAL" -eq 0 ]; then exit 0; fi; echo ''; echo "[observability] $CRIT critical, $HIGH high gaps in $(basename $FILE_PATH):"; echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '[.files[].gaps[] | select(.severity=="critical" or .severity=="high")] | sort_by(if .severity=="critical" then 0 else 1 end) | .[0:3][] | "  Line \(.line): \(.description)"' 2>/dev/null; echo 'Fix these — add structured logging with error context.'

TOOL_INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if ! echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git\s+(commit|push)'; then exit 0; fi; SCANNER=$(find . -path '*/observability_coverage/analyzers/scan.py' -print -quit 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$SCANNER" ]; then exit 0; fi; FILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|py|go|java|rb|rs)$' | grep -viE '(test_|_test\.)' | head -15); if [ -z "$FILES" ]; then FILES=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|py|go|java|rb|rs)$' | grep -viE '(test_|_test\.)' | head -15); fi; if [ -z "$FILES" ]; then exit 0; fi; TC=0; TH=0; MSGS=''; for F in $FILES; do [ -f "$F" ] || continue; R=$(python3 "$SCANNER" "$F" --json 2>/dev/null); [ $? -eq 0 ] || continue; C=$(echo "$R" | jq -r '.critical // 0' 2>/dev/null); H=$(echo "$R" | jq -r '.high // 0' 2>/dev/null); TC=$((TC+C)); TH=$((TH+H)); if [ $((C+H)) -gt 0 ]; then G=$(echo "$R" | jq -r '[.files[].gaps[] | select(.severity=="critical" or .severity=="high")] | .[0:2][] | "  \(.file | split("/") | last):\(.line) \(.description)"' 2>/dev/null); MSGS="$MSGS\n$G"; fi; done; if [ $((TC+TH)) -eq 0 ]; then exit 0; fi; echo ''; echo "[observability pre-commit] $TC critical, $TH high gaps in staged files:"; echo -e "$MSGS" | head -8; echo 'Consider fixing observability gaps before committing.'
